home.description: Clean Shower Water Is The Foundation Of Health & Beauty
home.fit: **Device/hardware, not skincare.** eskiin sells a filtered showerhead on skin-and-hair benefit claims. High UGC fit in practice — the demo (filter discolouration after use, water testing) is inherently visual and testimonial-driven — but the hook logic is problem-agitation about water quality, not actives or routine. Treat as its own angle set. Claim caution: the homepage runs 'prevent hair loss' and 'clears skin' as a scrolling marquee, which are strong claims for a hardware product.
